name: Speed, distance and time

default.aim: Choose the relationship using the quantity requested and matching units.
steps: Write three labelled lines: distance, speed and time. Fill in the known values with their units and put a ? beside the quantity to find. For several journey stages, make a row for each stage, including any stop.
Use hours with km/h:
. Include stops when total elapsed time is requested.
Use
, distance = speed × time, or time = distance ÷ speed.
For a whole journey use
; round only the final result and include units.
Divide the total distance by the full elapsed time, including stops when requested; do not average the individual speeds.

speed.name: Find speed from distance and time
speed.when: Distance and elapsed time are known.
steps: Express time in the units needed by the speed.
Divide distance by time.
speed.check: Use speed × time to recover distance, and check the units and the size of the result.

distance.name: Find distance from speed and time
steps: Match the time unit to the speed unit.
Multiply speed by time.
distance.check: Use speed × time to recover distance, and check the units and the size of the result.

time.name: Find time from distance and speed
steps: Divide distance by speed.
Give the result in the time unit used by the speed.
time.check: Use speed × time to recover distance, and check the units and the size of the result.

minutes.name: Convert minutes to hours
minutes.when: Time is given in minutes but speed is in km/h.
steps: Divide the number of minutes by 60.
Use that value in the chosen relationship.
minutes.check: Use speed × time to recover distance, and check the units and the size of the result.

journey.name: Find average speed for a whole journey
journey.when: Several journey stages have different distances or times.
steps: Add all the distances.
Add all elapsed travel times.
Divide total distance by total time.
journey.check: Use speed × time to recover distance, and check the units and the size of the result.

stops.name: Include stops in elapsed time
stops.when: A whole-journey average is requested and the journey includes a stop.
steps: Add the stop duration to the travel times.
Divide the total distance by the full elapsed time.
stops.check: Use speed × time to recover distance, and check the units and the size of the result.
